crossRefs.note: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly…
All of them come for violence. Their hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.
If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

translations.web: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
translations.bsb: Trembling with excitement, he devours the distance; he cannot stand still when the ram’s horn sounds.
translations.kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
translations.asv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage; Neither believeth he that it is the voice of the trumpet.
